BEMW.description: Boundary Element for Wall (BEMW). Fields are driven by two toggles: BBNDR_ELEM_METHOD enables the boundary-element method (requiring NMETHOD_TYPE) and BBOT_STOR marks the bottom story (requiring STOR_NAME).

BBNDR_ELEM_METHOD.description: Whether the boundary element method is applied to the wall. When true, NMETHOD_TYPE must be provided.

BBOT_STOR.description: Whether this wall is at the bottom story. When true, STOR_NAME must be provided and must reference an existing story.

STOR_NAME.description: [BBOT_STOR=true] Name of the existing story used as the bottom story.
